answer_1.quote: We leverage LLMs to generate synthetic data for various multilingual commonsense reasoning tasks, XCOPA, XWinograd, and XStoryCloze, where the training data is limited ...
answer_1.outputs: synthetic training examples (premise, question, two alternatives) for multilingual commonsense reasoning

answer_4.quote: To better evaluate the quality of the generated datasets and compare them with the human-created data, we ask native speakers to annotate the multilingual data generated by ChatGPT and GPT-4... request two annotators to evaluate the examples in two categories: (1) Text Naturalness... (2) Logic Soundness... For XWinograd, we introduce an additional evaluation criterion. Annotators are asked to determine whether the two noun phrases in the examples can be replaced by the same pronoun.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose among predefined options for Text Naturalness (natural, awkward but understandable, not understandable) and for Logic Soundness (correct option more plausible, both equally plausible, both implausible, wrong option more plausible). For XWinograd they also assess pronoun interchangeability.
